summary.name: DEAN HUSAIN
summary.title: Systems & Network Specialist
summary.description: Computer Science graduate specializing in Network Security and Systems Administration. Direct hands-on experience designing independent homelab security architectures—including air-gapped container environments, virtual machines, and segmented 802.1Q VLAN topologies—alongside freelance IT support. Proficient in Windows & Linux system hardening, Podman/Docker isolation, Wireshark, Nmap, and custom OS/firmware deployment.

education.degree: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science (Network Security Concentration)

projects.title: Enterprise-Grade Infrastructure & Network Security Deployment
bullets: Deployed OpenWrt custom firmware onto Google Nest routers (NLS-1304-25) to unlock advanced Layer 3 routing and granular enterprise capabilities.
Architected a securely segmented network topology using 802.1Q VLANs to isolate Management, IoT, Guest, and Security traffic, reducing internal attack surfaces.
Engineered strict firewall zone policies to block unauthorized cross-VLAN communication, securing management interfaces (Ports 22, 80, 443).
Configured a managed Netgear GS308E switch with tagged (trunk) and untagged (access) ports across wireless edge access points and hardwired infra.
Provisioned static IP reservations for high-availability self-hosted services (Pi-hole, Home Assistant, DVR), preparing for future B.A.T.M.A.N. mesh routing.

projects.title: Self Hosted & Air-Gapped Container Architecture
bullets: Proactively hardened containerized Python environments against supply chain risks (e.g., npm compromises) to protect local AI workloads from dependency poisoning.
Implemented a dual-container architecture separating update tasks from execution via an internet-facing container and a synchronized air-gapped instance.
Created a custom software-defined network interface in Podman dropping all outbound traffic to completely isolate local AI workloads (ComfyUI, Open WebUI).
Authored custom Containerfiles to build hardened, pre-configured base images for archival and rapid deployment.
Configured persistent local storage via volume mounts mapping host directories to container spaces for stateful data retention.

experience.title: IT Solutions Consultant
bullets: Performed Layer 1–2 physical infrastructure installs for clients, including structured low-voltage cabling, coax/BNC termination, and media converter setups.
Provisioned, configured, and deployed end-user workstation hardware, managing operating system installations, software baselines, and peripheral integration.
Delivered Tier 2 remote technical support and endpoint troubleshooting via TeamViewer and RDP, resolving OS-level errors, driver conflicts, and software bugs.
Deployed IP and analog CCTV security systems, configuring NVR/DVR storage units, local IP assignment, and remote monitoring access for clients.
Performed deep system diagnostics, malware remediation, and hardware bench repairs to restore performance and safeguard client data integrity.

experience.title: Web-Design Intern
bullets: Collaborated in weekly refinement sessions to translate layout mind maps into a fully functional multi-page site using Webflow.
Engineered and tested responsive breakpoints and alignment configurations for mobile and desktop devices.
Prototyped high-fidelity landing page animations using Adobe After Effects and integrated Lottie files for performance optimization.
Applied core HTML/CSS principles within visual development environments to enforce clean frontend layouts.
